applicant_facts.text: Application goes to the Commissioner of the Revenue
New application due within 30 days of establishing the business
Zoning approval is required before operating
Assumed/fictitious names registered with the State Corporation Commission
Flat $35 fee if gross receipts are $50,000 or less
Flat $50 fee if gross receipts are $50,001-$100,000
Over $100,000: the tax rate for the business class applies
First year is based on estimated gross receipts; later years on the prior year
Late filing/payment: 10% penalty plus 8% annual interest
